perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: The compact path keeps one source-relative macro posture or lighting read first, adds only independently drifting P0/P1 relations that the summary loses, and refuses integration when a required causal owner lane or module is absent.
perceptual_contract.user_appeal: Retain the source's particular posture, lighting direction across form, and shading distribution instead of producing a more centered and evenly lit generic result.

invariants.statement: A P0/P1 macro spatial result is checked with viewpoint and crop held fixed, and only source-visible relations that remain at risk survive as residual controls.

A compact lighting summary cannot replace material target/reference region, bright-plane coverage, local form contrast, gradient extent, shadow topology, material response, background spill, or pose dependency relations that drift independently.
Every route-required P0/P1 cross-lane residual names a present target lane and a module assigned to that lane, otherwise validation reports route-gap.
Runtime rules contain no motivating angle, side, anatomy, garment, color, regional numeric threshold, named lighting preset, or generator-specific response default.

flexible_dimensions: whether a macro summary is sufficient, lossy, or uncertain
which regional Light/Form relations are material
literal source-supported wording and downstream render variation

mismatches.source_state: The source read depends on a low viewpoint plus jointly material off-axis and depth-order relations.
mismatches.render_state: The delivered result preserves low viewpoint but normalizes the subject toward a centered, symmetric, near-frontal arrangement.

mismatches.source_state: Major visible regions carry distinct light-to-form, shadow, material-response, and background relations.
mismatches.render_state: The delivered result shifts those regional relations while the prompt relies primarily on a broad lighting summary and a generic under-form shadow cue.

hypotheses.statement: A compact posture or lighting label is lossy unless its coverage of the source-visible relations that jointly create the macro read is explicitly checked.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unrelated compact cases preserve all viewer-material spatial and Light/Form relations from macro-only findings without a loss audit, while loss-audited cases add no useful distinction.

hypotheses.statement: A material effect discovered by one lane can disappear before integration when its declared causal owner lane or module is absent and handoffs have no deterministic closure check.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out routes with absent P0/P1 owner lanes reliably preserve and causally own those effects without structured closure or rerouting.

hypotheses.statement: Placing camera and macro pose before at-risk spatial residuals, then pose-bound Light/Form before surface and capture, reduces later prose that neutralizes the intended spatial or shading relation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out prompt comparisons show no reduction in pose or Light/Form contradiction, or show that the causal order consistently weakens the primary proposition.

intervention.general_rule: Use compact-v2 findings with atomic or macro-summary representation. A macro declares sufficient, lossy, or uncertain adequacy; sufficient emits no residuals, while lossy or uncertain emits only source-supported P0/P1 at-risk relations. Close every cross-lane causal residual against a routed target lane and assigned module, otherwise return route-gap. Keep pose-bound Light/Form after its owning spatial relation and before surface or capture effects.
intervention.generalization_basis: The rule is parameterized by source-owned region and relation ids, causal axes, summary coverage, route membership, and module assignment. It selects no preferred pose, light, shadow, subject, wording, or numeric target, and fixtures exercise both under- and over-actuation plus present and absent causal owners.

decision.rationale: The compact contract now distinguishes atomic findings from macro summaries, rejects both residual omission and residual overactuation, and treats an absent P0/P1 causal owner as a bounded route-gap. The change is implemented and source-neutral structural fixtures pass. No independent post-change prompt extraction, new render, registered pixel comparison, or post-change user review was performed, so prompt behavior, render fidelity, and user preference remain unscored.
